items.title: 61530_Roy Eldridge oral history interview
items.q: Some records are going to show up sooner or later with Shorty Sherock, myself, and Lloyd Hundley, and Tony DiAmore on piano.

ctx.x: Yeah, the Chesterfield show. That was a farce, too, man! That's just one thing... I got out of there in a hurry, man. And also, the producer...in fact, he committed suicide. He was a good cat. Did you ever hear of a trumpet player named Lloyd Hundley? He was a good trumpet player. A Black cat. Some records are going to show up sooner or later with Shorty Sherock, myself, and Lloyd Hundley, and Tony DiAmore on piano. We played "The Sheik" and some other things, you know.
